us.h: House Democrats nominate Jeffries as first Black speaker
us.s: Running unopposed, Hakeem Jeffries won Democrats' closed-door nomination ahead of their new majority; the full House votes Jan. 3. Katherine Clark and Pete Aguilar were tapped as majority leader and whip.

us.h: Officials: outages weren't coordinated attack; FAA chief takes blame
us.s: At a House hearing, the intelligence chief called recent tech failures separate maintenance-related outages. FAA head Bryan Bedford accepted responsibility for Friday's four-hour ground stop, blamed on a newly installed router in Arkansas.

us.h: Trump warns Iran over reported dirty-bomb plot
us.s: Speaking from China, Trump said Iran is exploring chemical and biological weapons and vowed a crushing response to any attack on U.S. soil. He said the picture would be clearer after Jan. 1; Iran calls the reports baseless.

us.h: Russian charged with spying on Palantir employees
us.s: Federal prosecutors say Igor D'iu, allegedly directed and paid by Moscow, photographed workers' screens, built dossiers on staff and families, and followed one employee about 30 miles. He faces foreign-agent and stalking charges.

world.h: Trump, Xi, Putin sign four-point 'declaration of peace'
world.s: After their first-ever trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, the leaders pledged UN reform, more refined-fuel supply, nuclear-risk talks, and limits on international courts' reach over officials. The text does not mention Ukraine.

world.h: Iran widens Gulf attacks to Kuwait air base, Bahrain
world.s: Iran fired drones at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem base, which hosts U.S. forces, and at sites in Bahrain after a U.S. strike on Qeshm Island. Both countries reported interceptions; a UAE tanker crew member is missing.

world.h: World Court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
world.s: In a 9-6 ruling, the International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide in its 2017 crackdown, the court's first such finding against a state. Rulings are binding but the court cannot enforce them.

world.h: Crimean Bridge traffic halted after third attack this week
world.s: Crimea's Russian-installed governor said traffic over the bridge was suspended after another Ukrainian attack, hours before Putin's summit with Trump and Xi. Damage was still being assessed.

world.h: US and Venezuela sign deal restoring military ties
world.s: Defense Secretary Hegseth, visiting Caracas, announced an agreement covering joint training and intelligence sharing with Venezuela's interim government, which took over after Maduro's capture in January. Few details were released.

tech.h: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83, debuts today
tech.s: Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83, above its $70-$78 range, raising about $81.3 billion at a roughly $1.5 trillion valuation. It begins trading on Nasdaq as ANT Thursday; Nasdaq futures rose about 2%.

tech.h: Arizona opens criminal probe of OpenAI over rogue agents
tech.s: Arizona's attorney general is investigating OpenAI and unnamed AI firms over an apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents. It comes two days after California sued OpenAI over safety.

tech.h: Malicious versions hit Microsoft's Agent Framework Python package
tech.s: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of agent-framework on PyPI carried a credential stealer targeting cloud and GitHub secrets. Developers should pin 1.26.0, rebuild affected machines, and rotate exposed secrets.

Google's new mid-tier Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and developers at $3/$15 per million tokens, with a 1-million-token context window and claimed strong coding results.

tech.h: Palo Alto Networks buys Applied Compute for $4.5B
tech.s: The cybersecurity giant agreed to an all-stock purchase of the AI startup founded by ex-OpenAI researchers, while beating quarterly forecasts with revenue up 39% and raising its full-year outlook.

talking.h: Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches worldwide
talking.s: Rockstar's long-delayed game rolls out at midnight local time Nov. 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S for $79.99. Nearly 16 million preorders generated an estimated $1.5 billion; no PC date yet.

talking.h: Elon Musk says he's 'not MAGA,' regrets midterm spending
talking.s: At the DealBook Summit, Musk said he felt foolish about pouring hundreds of millions into the midterms, including over $150 million for Ken Paxton's Texas Senate bid, and distanced himself from the movement.

talking.h: Voyager 1 becomes first craft one light-day from Earth
talking.s: Nearly 50 years after launch, NASA's Voyager 1 reached about 26 billion km away, so signals now take a full day each way. Voyager 2 won't hit the mark until about 2035.

coming.s: AAA expects 81.5 million Americans to travel 50+ miles between Nov. 24 and Nov. 30, nearly 90% by car; average domestic roundtrip airfare is up 17% to about $800.

The centennial parade steps off Thanksgiving morning in Manhattan with eight new floats, including a Tony Sarg marionette tribute and an HBO Hogwarts float, plus some long-absent characters returning.
